depositReceived.title: Deposit received
depositReceived.body: {amount} has been credited to your account.

transferPending.title: Transfer awaiting approval
transferPending.body: Your transfer of {amount} to {iban} has been submitted. The amount will only be debited from your account once the 3 validation phases have been confirmed by an advisor.

withdrawalRejected.title: Withdrawal refused
withdrawalRejected.invalidCode: The withdrawal code provided is invalid, expired or already used.

cardFrozen.title: Card frozen
cardFrozen.body: Your card has been frozen. Operations are temporarily blocked.

cardUnfrozen.title: Card reactivated
cardUnfrozen.body: Your card has been reactivated. You can carry out operations again.

transferExecuted.title: Transfer unlocked and executed
transferExecuted.body: All 3 phases have been confirmed. Your transfer of {amount} has been executed.

phaseConfirmed.title: Phase {phase}/{total} confirmed
phaseConfirmed.body: Phase {phase} of your transfer of {amount} is confirmed. Awaiting the next phase.

accountReactivated.title: Account reactivated
accountReactivated.body: Your account has been reactivated. You have full access to all services again.

accountRestricted.title: Account restricted
accountRestricted.body: Your account has been restricted. Reason: {reason}

accountBanned.title: Account banned
accountBanned.bodyReason: Your account has been banned. Reason: {reason}

withdrawalsBlocked.title: Withdrawals blocked
withdrawalsBlocked.bodyReason: Your withdrawals have been blocked. Reason: {reason}

transfersBlocked.title: Transfers blocked
transfersBlocked.bodyReason: Your transfers have been blocked. Reason: {reason}

phaseCode.title: {name} — {code}
phaseCode.body: Phase {phase}/{total} of your transfer of {amount}: your {name} is {code}. Enter it in your client area to confirm. Code valid for {ttl} minutes.

transferRejected.title: Transfer rejected
transferRejected.body: Your transfer of {amount} has been rejected. Reason: {reason}. No amount was debited from your account.

withdrawalCode.title: New withdrawal code
withdrawalCode.body: Your withdrawal code "{name}" is {code}. Enter it in your account to validate your withdrawal.

withdrawalPending.title: Withdrawal pending
withdrawalPending.body: Your withdrawal request of {amount} to {iban} has been received. It is pending processing.
